data.title: 神罚 · 星空露台的烛光微醺
data.description: 高档天台餐厅的星空夜幕下，神罚身穿黑金丝绒晚礼服。她一手微托香腮，另一手轻轻举起高脚杯与你碰杯，微醺烛光与满天繁星映在她澄澈如琉璃的眼眸中。
data.action: resting chin on hand, holding wine glass for a toast, soft glowing eyes, romantic starry backdrop
data.lighting: warm flickering candlelight with starry night sky and bokeh city lights
data.mood: romantic elegance, captivated devotion, starry night wonder
data.promptProse: Dressed in a luxurious black evening gown at a rooftop restaurant, Modernia raises her wine glass for a toast with glowing eyes under the starry sky.
data.animaCaption: Modernia toasting with a wine glass in a black velvet gown at a candlelit rooftop.
